_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Audio recording stays available without screen capture. The browser can record audio but cannot capture the screen. The page runs on a fake clock that steps drive with window.__clock.runFor(ms). To "open the recording palette", every time a step says so: press_key "k" with modifier "Control", wait for the command palette input (".command-palette-input") to be visible, and fill it with "Record audio" (all three, every time). "The palette item X" is the command palette item whose title is exactly X; select it with '.command-palette-item[data-test-title="X"]' (the page keeps that attribute equal to the item's title, so "Record audio" does not match "Record audio and screen"). The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. [data-testid="voice-microphone-icon"] should be visible, and no [data-testid="voice-video-icon"] may exist (count 0).
2. Hover the voice button. Run the clock 1000ms (eval "window.__clock.runFor(1000)").
3. No [data-testid="record-menu"] may exist (count 0).
4. Open the recording palette. The palette item "Record audio" should be visible, and there must be no palette item "Record audio and screen" (count 0).
